afterFileEdit.name: lint-check
afterFileEdit.prompt: Check if the edited file follows the project's coding standards defined in .apm/instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md. If there are violations, list them with specific line numbers and suggest fixes.

preToolUse.name: security-guard
preToolUse.prompt: Before executing this tool, verify that no secrets, API keys, tokens, or credentials are being written to any file. If detected, block the action and warn the user.
